title: Chapter 310 Mystery Of Gods And Demons
content:
Chapter 310 Mystery Of Gods And Demons

Zhong Yu stands high above his small world, because this world is created because of it, so in this world, he is an omnipotent god.

Standing in the cold and windy sky, the gust of wind whizzed by, bringing up a purple robe and hunting.

However, Zhong Yu didn't care about the clothes on his body. Instead, he focused his gaze on the world below, his creation, and the foundation of everything.

After a long time of plundering in the world of Qin Shi, Zhong Yu gained nearly tens of millions of luck points. In addition to taking out some of these luck points for self-cultivation, and providing them as salaries to his subordinates.

The rest are provided to this small world as nourishment to help him grow.

Now, with the continuous supply of nutrients, this small world has grown to the size of a province.

Moreover, the aura in the world is getting stronger and stronger, and ordinary people feel refreshed after taking a breath, and their minor ailments have subsided, which is extremely miraculous and unpredictable.

The evolution of this world drove Zhong Yu's breakthrough. His strength broke through the fifth-order mortal barrier, and he stepped into the mysterious realm of leaving the mortal world and heading for eternity.

Now that Zhong Yu is already a sixth-level existence, if he switches to the Western mythology system, he will be a demigod who has acquired divinity and has not yet ignited the divine fire. Switching to the Eastern cultivation system, that is a great cultivator at the golden core stage, with a lifespan of thousands of years.

However, although Zhong Yu's cultivation system is different from the two, his lifespan is still more than 500 years.

But because of that damned curse, its lifespan was firmly restricted, unless it could break through to the eighth level, completely shed its mortal body, and become a fairy god, it would be able to unravel this curse.

"Time is running out!"

Sighing lightly, Zhong Yu's eyes showed some confusion, and even some fear. It is the sadness of my aging body and the growing feeling that I am slowly approaching death.

In the world of Mingyue in Qin Dynasty, Zhong Yu was delayed for 17 years; in the world of the Three Kingdoms, he was delayed for another five years; in the original Western world of gods and demons, he was delayed for another year. Counting the three worlds, a full 23 years have passed like this.

And Zhong Yu was already a 22-year-old youth before time travelling. Counting the time after time travel, he is now 45 years old, an old man who is nearly half a century old. It can be said that half a leg has stepped into the gate of death.

Although it is impossible for him to die at the age of seventy or eighty with his cultivation base and the support of the whole country, he should reach the limit of a mortal and die at the age of a hundred.

But even so, with one hundred years old as the limit, he only has 55 years of life left, and 55 years are left for him to break through.

The difference between immortals and mortals is so great, and it takes so many hardships and dangers to break through this barrier.

Looking at those cultivation matters, the efforts and time spent in order to become immortals and gods are calculated in tens of millions of years, and it is still very slim whether they will succeed in the end.

And he has only 55 years, although the exercises he cultivated are extremely against the sky, he still has an empire as his backing, and there is even the existence of cheating such as crossing.

But in the end, whether he can become a fairy or a god, Zhong Yu still has no idea.

However, after all, Zhong Yu has experienced many turbulent waves, he is a figure who leads a country, and he is also a god in a small world. His troubles about this point were soon completely suppressed by the corner of his heart.

"Now that I have completely controlled the world of Qin Shimingyue, I don't know why when I controlled the world of heaven and humanity, there was no mythical figure like Nine Heavens Profound Girl. Is it strange?" Zhong Yu frowned. Brows, feeling very puzzled.

It stands to reason, based on the anime he watched in his previous life, as well as the many materials he collected after such a long period of exploration in Qin Shi's world. It all proves that thousands of years ago in this world, there were still existences with strengths above the sixth level.

At least the Nine Heavens Xuannv and Huangdi Chiyou are real existences. Because Zhong Yu found the hidden God of Soldiers and Chi You's magic sword in the ancient country of Loulan in the Western Regions.

During that harvest, those Loulan survivors were still so ignorant that they resisted the master Wang, and then they were crushed to pieces by Zhong Yu's army.

These are not important survivors of Loulan. Although they can be regarded as a force that cannot be ignored, there are many such forces in the world, so it is not worth Zhong Yu's special recall.

What really mattered were the priests of these Loulan survivors.

There is a magical power in their bodies, which is completely different from the mainstream in the world, the internal power exercised by various sects.

The power in their bodies actually comes from faith, through the belief in the Nine Heavens Profound Girl, and then because of their devout faith, they obtain divine power, which makes them different from ordinary people.

This kind of strange thing can't help but make Zhong Yu feel strange.

He is no stranger to this kind of power, he has encountered it in the Western world of gods and demons before.

The aboriginals in those places believed in their ancestors, so they obtained the divine power bestowed by those demigod ancestors, and obtained extraordinary powers.

Although the power of the priests of the Nine Heavens Xuannv in the world of Qin Shi is slightly different from that of the priests of western gods and demons. But in the final analysis, they are still the same in essence, they are all divine power purified by the power of faith.

Through this, Zhong Yu can definitely confirm that Nine Heavens Xuannv is indeed a demigod. And she can also perceive with her followers, respond to their priests, and give her followers power.

However, through observation, it seems that the Nine Heavens Xuannv has left this world and stepped into another more mysterious world. But I don't know what method was used, but it can still cause some impact in this world, it is really hard to guess.

Thinking of this, Zhong Yu couldn't help but feel a little bit afraid of the Nine Heavens Xuannv who has never met but only knows a little bit.

At the same time, I feel even more fortunate that the Nine Heavens Xuannv left, otherwise it would be impossible for me, who was only at the fourth level of cultivation at that time, to resist this kind of existence.

"However, although Xuannv Jiutian left, the things he left behind have provided me with great help. I should thank him very much!" A trace of gratitude flashed in Zhong Yu's eyes, but it was fleeting.

It turned out that although Nine Heavens Profound Girl left this world, she still shed a tear because she was worried about the God of Soldiers left behind by her old friend Chi You.

This tear has the divinity left by the Nine Heavens Xuannv, and then turned into a young girl Xiao Li. His mission is to protect Loulan, and seal the Demon God to prevent him from being born and harming the world.

After Zhong Yu unified the world and completely controlled the world of Qin Shi, his cultivation base skyrocketed under the influence of the law of casting the holy court. It quickly broke through the world barrier and entered the fifth order, and climbed all the way to the peak of the fifth order.

However, the trend of soaring cultivation base soon stopped, and finally stabilized at the peak of the fifth-order, and it was impossible to break through the hurdle of the sixth-order divine creature.

Then the Tears of the Goddess helped him, and Zhong Yu killed Xiao Li who had been transformed into Tears of the Goddess, and beat it back to its original God's Tears. By absorbing this drop of divine tears, plus the dragon element extracted from the body of the mythical beast Pixiu.

Finally broke through the sixth level and entered the existence of divinity.

Regardless of this help, Zhong Yu was very grateful to Nine Heavens Profound Girl.
